_meta.description: CareerBridge resume parser extraction output (ResumeContent). Produced by parseExtractedResumeText() in apps/api/src/resumes/parse-extracted-resume.ts after PDF/DOCX text extraction.
_meta.note: Example values below are illustrative only — not hardcoded from any real resume.

extracted.summary: Experienced engineer focused on delivery and product ownership.

experiences.description:
Built product roadmap
Led client delivery

fieldSources.fullName: Header / Personal Details (first non-contact short line)
fieldSources.city: Header contact line, City/State patterns, or Personal Details Address/Location labels → stored as city string
fieldSources.skills: SKILLS / TOOLS / TECHNOLOGIES sections + programming tokens misfiled under Languages + high-confidence tech mentions in experience/projects
fieldSources.education: EDUCATION / ACADEMIC* section; one object per degree (MCA, BCA, B.Tech, etc.)
fieldSources.experiences: EXPERIENCE* section; one object per employer; Role & Responsibilities appended into description when present
fieldSources.languages: LANGUAGES section — human languages only (English, Hindi, …)
fieldSources.achievements: ACHIEVEMENTS / AWARDS section — stops at next major heading
fieldSources.projects: PROJECTS section — stops at Achievements / Experience / Personal Details / etc.
fieldSources.links: URLs found anywhere in raw text (LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio)

notExtractedAsSeparateTopLevelFields.state: Kept inside city string when found (e.g. "Patna, Bihar") — schema uses city only
notExtractedAsSeparateTopLevelFields.country: Not a separate ResumeContent field today
notExtractedAsSeparateTopLevelFields.address: Mapped into city / personal location text when present
notExtractedAsSeparateTopLevelFields.responsibilities: No top-level array; merged into experiences[].description
